scope: Pinned text inspection of Burgers neural entrypoint, generator and README; binary ICs remain unopened.

unresolved_findings.finding: No installation recipe or complete environment specification is supplied; Python/PyTorch versions alone do not satisfy the R2 environment/install gate.
Active training unconditionally loads absent checkpoint500.pt, including optimizer and scheduler states; no complete cold-start curriculum driver is supplied.
The full trajectory required by the neural entrypoint is unbundled; generation code and initial-condition files do not establish the exact paper trajectory or bundled-IC mapping.
Generator output ./data/2dBurgers/ differs from neural input ./data/ for the same trajectory filename; no transfer/setup instruction resolves the paths.
Relative model, figure and data directories require downstream preparation; the inspected entrypoint does not create them.
CUDA is required in active source, but GPU model, memory and CUDA runtime version are not specified.
Evaluation code and README extrapolation claims provide no verified numerical baseline or acceptance threshold for the extracted configuration.

notes: Single-resource checkpoint for recurrent solver and resumed training semantics. No scientific workload was executed.
